Every new product, service, or feature we invent is the result of people working together to make each other’s ideas stronger. That happens here because every one of us strives toward a common goal — creating the best customer experiences. Just one example: The incredibly advanced camera features in every new iPhone are not the result of a few dozen people. Multiply that effort across every feature in every Apple product, and you’ll get an idea of how important collaboration is here.

And we lead the industry with efforts to reduce our impact on climate change, find ways to use greener materials, and conserve the Earth’s valuable resources.

Our customers are all over the world, so it’s by design that Apple employees are all over the world, too.
